brief.en: A listener strongly favors synthetic-track-0058 and manually selected it before, but played it at 2026-07-29T11:40:00Z. At the 2026-07-29T12:00:00Z reference time they begin the shared familiar night-highway journey. The five-track plan should exclude synthetic-track-0058 despite its strong preference evidence.

expected_delta.en: Removing only the recent-play list should restore the favorite track to the plan.

rationale.en: The pair changes only profile.played_items, isolating the recent-play exclusion from affinity, recovery, route, seed, and service choice. Grounded in CDC-SU Slides 66–80 (OSHI, preference, and recent-operation inputs to content prioritization).
rationale.ja: 対ではprofile.played_itemsだけを変え、直近再生除外を親和性・回復・ルート・seed・サービス選択から分離する。 CDC-SUスライド66–80（推し・嗜好・直近操作を用いたコンテンツ優先順位）に基づく。

narrative.en: At the 2026-07-29T12:00:00Z reference time they begin the shared familiar night-highway journey. Monotony produces a supported content request without changing the fixed recent-play history.
